svg.title: One sentence, two ways to edit it: the fidelity contract
svg.desc: A synthetic manuscript sentence. Unbounded polishing drops its hedges and changes a number; with Academic Writing Assistant only the language is improved, while hedges, numbers and citations stay as written.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
